sentences.en: A panda escaped from his enclosure at the Copenhagen Zoo.
sentences.zh: Copenhagen 动物园的一只大熊猫逃出了它的围场。

sentences.en: The snow leopard cubs played with ropes inside their enclosure.
sentences.zh: 雪豹幼崽在它们的围场里用绳子玩耍。

sentences.en: Ziri wanted to see the bat enclosure at the zoo.
sentences.zh: Ziri 想要看动物园里的蝙蝠围场。
